superlatives.title: Team of the Week
superlatives.description: Highest team score in the completed week.

superlatives.title: Dumpster Fire of the Week
superlatives.description: Lowest team score in the completed week.

superlatives.title: Not Good Enough
superlatives.description: Highest-scoring team that still lost its matchup.

superlatives.title: Biggest Upset
superlatives.description: Biggest projected-score underdog that still won, used when Yahoo's completed snapshot no longer contains usable pre-matchup win probability.

superlatives.title: Biggest Choke
superlatives.description: Largest negative difference between actual score and pre-matchup projected score.

superlatives.title: The Fraud
superlatives.description: Lowest score among the week's winners.

superlatives.title: Statement Win
superlatives.description: Largest margin of victory in the completed week.

superlatives.title: Explosion
superlatives.description: Largest jump above the team's average score from prior completed weeks.

superlatives.title: Trending Up
superlatives.description: Biggest improvement over the team's immediately preceding completed-week score.

superlatives.title: Trending Down
superlatives.description: Biggest decline versus the team's immediately preceding completed-week score.

superlatives.title: Donkey of the Week
superlatives.description: A losing team made a start/sit decision that cost it a win. Each bench player is compared only with starters at positions that player is eligible to fill; the award goes to the swap producing the largest winning margin. Only completed matchups count.
